name: Cornu Copia -Fushigi no Sumu Machi-
original_name: コルヌ・コピア －不思議の住む街－
source:
Half a year since studying abroad in an art school in France, Kouta, a Japanese person who abruptly lost his savings and residence due to unavoidable circumstances, finds a ray of hope across from the station ticket gate.

"Recruiting a live-in private tutor. Seeking someone who fully understands social etiquette of human society."

Kouta tears off the rather strange part-time recruitment leaflet.

Lost inside the hustle and bustle of the train platform, he comes across a girl with horns and a boy with wolf ears.
Together, they reach the town of Cornucopia after a bumpy ride, and Kouta becomes aware of the "Fushigi Kemono" who live there.

[Translated from the [url=http://amateru.boo.jp/sakuhin/cornu/intro.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
日本人幸太在法国艺术学校留学半年后，因不得已而突然失去了积蓄和住所，在车站检票口对面找到了一线希望。

“招聘一名住家家庭教师，寻找一个完全了解人类社会社交礼仪的人。”

幸太撕下了那张相当奇怪的兼职招聘传单。

他迷失在喧嚣的站台中，遇到了一个长着角的女孩和一个长着狼耳朵的男孩。
经过一番颠簸，他们一起到达了聚宝盆镇，幸太意识到居住在那里的“不死兽”。

[翻译自[url=http://amateru.boo.jp/sakuhin/cornu/intro.html]官方网站[/url]]
